                             PLANNING COMMISSION STAFF REPORT
MEETING DATE:        September 15, 2022
PROJECT NUMBERS:     S-22-006
REQUESTS:            A petition for a preliminary subdivision plat amendment to consolidate seven
                     existing parcels into one parcel.
ADDRESS:             2354 S State Street
PARCEL NUMBERS:      16-19-153-004; 005; 006; 007; 008; 009; 010
PROPERTY OWNER:      Edison Way LLC
APPLICANT:           Ross Robb on behalf of Parallel Acquisitions, LLC

SYNOPSIS:
Ross Robb, on behalf of Edison Way LLC is
proposing redevelopment of seven existing
parcels located around 2354 S State Street.
The redevelopment would be an apartment
building with 319 rental units. In order to
redevelop, the applicant is making two
requests.

Edison Way LLC is petitioning the Planning
Commission for the approval of an
amendment to the subdivision plat to
consolidate seven existing parcels located
at 2354 S State Street into one parcel.

Edison Way LLC also submitted an application for a Conditional Use Permit (“CUP”) for a Multi-Family
Dwelling. The CUP application will be on the Planning Commission’s agenda for review at the time of
the final subdivision plat.


The Planning Commission is the Land Use Authority on all subdivision plat applications. Additionally, all
conditional use permit applications require approval from the Planning Commission.

STAFF RECOMMENDATION:
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission move to approve, with conditions, the petition for a
preliminary subdivision plat amendment to consolidate seven existing parcels located at 2354 S State
Street. Staff’s recommendation is based upon its analysis and findings included below.

PLANNING COMMISSION AUTHORITY:
17.11.030. Land use authority designations.

Pursuant to state law, the following administrative land use authority designations are made:

   A. Planning Commission. The planning commission is the land use authority on issues of: subdivision
      and subdivision plat approval, vacating, altering or amending a Subdivision Plat; Conditional
      Use Permit Applications; design review for Building Heights as established in this Title; design
      review for projects on Parcels where any portion of the Parcel abuts any residential district; and
      the issuance of a Building or demolition permit in a Historic and Landmark district.

GENERAL PLAN CONSIDERATIONS:

Land Use & Neighborhoods Goal 1. Continue to welcome new residents and businesses into South Salt
Lake.

       Analysis: The proposed development will add an additional 319 new dwelling units in the city.

Land Use & Neighborhoods Goal 2. Concentrate higher density development near transportation and
transit in mixed use neighborhood.

       Analysis: The proposed development adds high-density development near the South Salt Lake
       City S-Line stop.
                                               9
Land Use & Neighborhoods Goal 3. Enhance urban and streetscape design in the city to support South
Salt Lake’s distinct image and enhance community pride.

       Analysis: The proposed development will improve the streetscape along State Street, Truman
       Avenue, and Burton Avenue.

Housing Goal 2. Connect housing of various densities to appropriate services and amenities within and
between neighborhoods.

      Analysis. The proposed development provides access to transit and includes a range of unit sizes
to accommodate different family sizes and needs.

Transportation Goal 2. Increase connections within and between neighborhoods to improve access to
amenities and services without requiring the use of an automobile.

      Analysis. The proposed development’s proximity to the S-Line stop would improve the access to
amenities and services without using an automobile.

Environmental, Social, and Economic Sustainability Goal 1. Reduce vehicle miles travels and improve air
quality.

       Analysis. The proposed development’s proximity to the S-Line stop would eliminate some of the
vehicle miles traveled, because public transportation would be used instead.



DESIGN REVIEW ANALYSIS
In accordance with Section 10 of the Downtown Code, a design review was conducted on Wednesday,
August 24, 2022 to “review the application for its compatibility with the intent of th[e] ordinance.”

The committee was comprised of the following departments: South Salt Lake (“SSL”) Mayor, SSL
Community Development, SSL Neighborhoods, SSL Finance, SSL Water, SSL Economic Development, SSL
City Attorney, SSL Fire, and SSL Police.

The main topic of discussion during the design review was clear view requirements. There was some
concern that the street trees would hinder visibility for drivers. Staff confirmed that the proposed species
of tree is compliant with the SSL Landscape Handbook. Staff has also made a condition that trees will
remain clear view compliant.

The design review committee had no major concerns about the proposed development.

STAFF RECOMMENDATION:
Based upon the information submitted in the application, supporting documentation, and analysis of
the relevant code sections and general plan goals, Staff recommends the Planning Commission move
to approve, with conditions, the preliminary subdivision plat amendment based on the findings of fact,
conclusions of law and conditions of approval for the subdivision in the staff report:

Findings of Fact:

   1.    On May 27, 2022, Ross Robb submitted a Subdivision application on behalf of Parallel
         Acquisitions, LLC to build and operate a 319-unit Multi-Family building located at 2354 S State
         Street.


                                                     16
   2.    The subject properties are located at 2354 S State Street.

   3.    The subject properties consist of seven separate lots.

   4.    All subject properties are located in the Downtown – Mixed Use subdistrict.

   5.    The proposed subdivision will consolidate the seven existing lots located at the above subject
         properties.

   6.    The proposed subdivision will create one lot that will be 1.73 acres in size.


   7.    The Multi-Family Dwelling use is a conditional land use in the Downtown District.

   8.    The subject properties currently have vacant buildings that will be demolished before
         construction begins.

   9.    The proposed lot will be served by existing and new vehicular and pedestrian access points on
         Truman and Burton Avenue.

   10.   Staff has reviewed this subdivision for compliance with SSL Municipal Code Section “17.10.140
         Subdivision Development Lot Standards” and found that this subdivision is compliant with this
         section, as outlined above.

   11.   Staff has reviewed this subdivision for compliance with SSL Municipal Code Section “17.10.150
         Subdivision and Condominium Plat Layout Requirements” and found that this subdivision is
         compliant with this section, as outlined above.

   12.   Staff has reviewed this subdivision for compliance with SSL Municipal Code Sections 17.10.160,
         17.10.170, 17.10.180, 17.10.190, 17.10.200, and 17.10.300, and found that this subdivision is
         compliant with those sections, as outlined above.

   13.   Staff has reviewed this subdivision for compliance with the SSL Downtown Code Sections 5, 6, 7,
         and found that this subdivision is compliant with those sections, as outlined above.


Conclusions of Law:

   1.    The subdivision and use, as specifically conditioned below, is consistent with the South Salt
         Lake City General Plan.

   2.    The subdivision and use, as specifically conditioned below is compatible in use, scale, and
         design with the allowed uses in Downtown District.

   3.    The subdivision and use, as specifically conditioned below, does not compromise the health,
         safety, or welfare of: Persons employed within or using the proposed development; Those
         residing or working in the vicinity of the proposed use or development; or Property or
         improvements in the vicinity of the proposed use or development.

   4.    The subdivision and use, as specifically conditioned below, does not impose disproportionate
         burdens on the citizens of the city.

Subdivision Plat Conditions of Approval:



                                                     17
  1.    The applicant will continue to work with City staff to make all technical corrections necessary
        prior to recording;

  2.    Prior to plat recordation and any additional development of the subsequent lot, the applicant
        must provide City staff the final plat mylar to include notarized signatures of owners’ consent
        to dedication; and obtain signatures of all entities indicated on the subdivision plat attached
        hereto;

  3.    The applicant shall complete (or post an adequate improvement completion assurance),
        warrant and post required warranty assurance for all required landscaping and public
        infrastructure improvements;

  4.    The applicant shall ensure, upon maturity, all street trees be and remain clear-view compliant;

  5.    The applicant shall ensure that all site improvements are installed consistent with the
        requirements of the South Salt Lake City Municipal Code;

  6.    The applicant shall dedicate an easement to the City of South Salt Lake for purposes of storm
        water management practices and ensure the plat includes language of the dedication of such
        easement, in a form as approved by the City Attorney’s Office;

  7.    The proposed building shall be constructed according to South Salt Lake design standards;

  8.    The proposed Multi-Family development shall meet all requirements of the South Salt Lake
        Community Development Department, South Salt Lake Fire Marshal, the South Salt Lake Building
        Official, and the South Salt Lake Engineering department;

  9.    The applicant shall maintain the 302 parking stalls that are shown on the proposed plans;

  10.   The applicant shall comply with all applicable International Building Codes and International
        Fire Codes and must obtain and complete a South Salt Lake building permit;

  11.   The applicant shall obtain a South Salt Lake City sign permit prior to any sign installation;

  12.   The applicant shall obtain approval from South Salt Lake City prior to any murals being painted;

  13.   The applicant shall follow through with the Conditional Use Permit application and obtain a
        conditional use permit prior to the South Salt Lake building permit being issued.

  14.   The applicant shall apply for and complete a South Salt Lake Business License application;

  15.   All items of the staff report.

PLANNING COMMISSION OPTIONS:
  Option 1: Approval
  Move to approve the application by Ross Robb, on behalf of Parallel Acquisitions, LLC for a
  preliminary subdivision plat amendment for a seven-lot subdivision consolidation of the subject
  properties located at 2354 S State Street based on the findings and conclusions in the staff report,
  with the conditions enumerated in the staff report and on the record.

  Option 2: Denial
  Move to deny the application by Ross Robb, on behalf of Parallel Acquisitions, LLC for a preliminary
  subdivision plat amendment for a seven-lot subdivision consolidation of the subject properties
  located at 2354 S State Street based on the findings stated on the record.


                                                    18
   Option 3: Continuance
   Move to table the decision on the application by Ross Robb, on behalf of Parallel Acquisitions, LLC
   for a preliminary subdivision plat amendment for a seven-lot subdivision consolidation of the subject
   properties located at 2354 S State Street to a date certain to allow the Applicant and Staff time to
   respond to specific inquiries or concerns raised by the Planning Commission, or to allow the Planning
   Commission more time to consider the proposal.

MEETING DATE:            September 15, 2022
PROJECT NUMBER:          S-21-009
REQUEST:                 A petition to the Planning Commission for preliminary plat approval to consolidate seven
                         existing parcels into 46 lot subdivision plat.
ADDRESS:                 3383 South 300 East and 354 East 3360 South
PARCEL NUMBER:           16-30-381-003; 004; 005; 006
                         16-30-456-003; 006; 016
PROPERTY OWNER:          300 Lofts, LLC
APPLICANT:               300 Lofts, LLC


 SYNOPSIS:
 300 Lofts, LLC is proposing redevelopment of seven existing parcels located at 3383 S. 300 E. and 354 E. 3360 S. In
 order to redevelop, the applicant is making two requests.

   1. 300 Lofts is petitioning the Planning Commission for preliminary plat approval for a 46-lot townhome subdivision
      located at 3383 S. 300 E. and 354 E. 3360 S.

   2. 300 Lofts is also petitioning the Planning Commission for a recommendation of approval to the City Council to
      amend the zoning to the Townhome Overlay.

 The subject property currently has five existing buildings/structures that will be demolished. The applicant intends to
 construct 12 townhome buildings containing 45 dwelling units and common amenity space for the property owners.

 The Planning Commission
 is the Land Use Authority
 on all subdivision plat
 applications           and
 amendments      and     an
 advisory body to make
 recommendations to the
 City Council on all zoning
 map amendments.

  Residential Multiple                                  Residential Townhomes
                          Property Park Operations                                              3360 South


STAFF RECOMMENDATION:
Staff recommends the Planning Commission move to approve a preliminary subdivision plat to consolidate seven
existing parcels into a 46-lot subdivision located at 3383 S. 300 E. and 354 E. 3360 S. Staff’s recommendation is
based upon its analysis and findings included below.

17.11.030. Land use authority designations.
Pursuant to state law, the following administrative land use authority designations are made:

   A.   Planning Commission. The planning commission is the land use authority on issues of: subdivision and
        subdivision plat approval, vacating, altering or amending a Subdivision Plat; Conditional Use permit

GENERAL PLAN CONSIDERATIONS:
        Applications; design review for Building Heights as established in this Title; design review for projects on
        Parcels where any portion of the Parcel abuts any residential district; and the issuance of a Building or
        demolition permit in a Historic and Landmark district.

                                                           6
Community Values Goal 2. Support neighborhood livability by creating pedestrian, bike, and play environments
appropriate to the surrounding housing types.

          Analysis: The proposed development will add to the livability of the area by adding new sidewalks, streets,
          and play environments within the development.

Community Values Goal 3. Take advantage of opportunities relating to the city’s location at the center of regional
transportation, transit, trials, open space, library, recreation, and school systems to serve residents, businesses, and
visitors.

          Analysis: The proposed development will be located 0.5 miles away from the new Granite Library. It is also
          surrounded by multiple bus stops as well as being 1 mile away from the Millcreek TRAX station.

Land Use & Neighborhoods Goal 1. Continue to welcome new residents and businesses into South Salt Lake.

          Analysis: The proposed development will create new housing for new residents to move into South Salt Lake.

Housing Goal 1. Encourage the equitable development of diverse, safe, affordable, and attractive housing that is
accessible and appropriate for residents of all incomes, needs, ages, backgrounds, and familial status.

          Analysis: The proposed development will add townhomes to an area that has multiple condominium and
          apartment buildings. This will add a different type of housing to the area that may be a better fit for potential
          residents than a condominium or apartment.

STAFF RECOMMENDATION:
Based upon the information submitted in the application, supporting documentation, and analysis of the relevant
code sections and general plan goals, Staff recommends the Planning Commission move to approve, with conditions,
the preliminary subdivision plat and proposes the following findings of fact and conclusions of law and conditions of
approval:

Findings of Fact:

   1.   The subject properties, located at 3383 South 300 East, consist of seven separate parcels.
   2.   All seven parcels are located in the Residential Multiple land use district.
                                                            9
   3.  The proposed zoning map amendment will add the Townhome Overlay (TO) to the existing zoning.
   4.  The proposed subdivision will create 46 lots that will total about 2.8 acres in size.
   5.  The property owner is applying for the subdivision and zoning amendment to construct a townhome
       development.
   6. The proposed development will be located in the Residential Multiple and Townhome Overlay land use
       districts.
   7. The proposed building falls into the Dwelling, Townhome land use category.
   8. The Dwelling, Townhome use is a permitted land use in the Townhome Overlay.
   9. The subject property currently has vacant buildings.
   10. The proposed project area will be served by new vehicular and pedestrian access points on 300 East and 3360
       South.
   11. Staff has reviewed this subdivision for compliance with SSL Municipal Code Sections 17.10.140, 17.10.150,
       17.10.160, 17.10.170, 17.10.180, 17.10.190, 17.10.200, and 17.10.300, and found that this subdivision is
       compliant with those sections, as outlined above.

Conclusions of Law:

   1.   The subdivision, as specifically conditioned below, is consistent with the South Salt Lake City General Plan.
   2.   The subdivision, as specifically conditioned below is compatible in use, scale, and design with the allowed uses
        in Commercial Corridor.
   3.   The subdivision as specifically conditioned below, does not compromise the health, safety, or welfare of:
        Persons employed within or using the proposed development; Those residing or working in the vicinity of the
        proposed use or development; or Property or improvements in the vicinity of the proposed use or
        development.
   4.   The subdivision, as specifically conditioned below does not impose disproportionate burdens on the citizens
        of the City.

Conditions of Approval:

   1.   If the zoning map amendment is approved, the petition for the zoning map amendment will not take effect
        until such time that the South Salt Lake Planning Commission grants the final plat approval of the subdivision
        plat, and said plat is recorded with the office of the Salt Lake County Recorder.
   2.   If the zoning map amendment is approved, and the applicant fails to record a final subdivision plat within 180
        days of final subdivision plat approval, the zoning map amendment petition approval is void.
   3.   The applicant will continue to work with City staff to make all technical corrections necessary prior to recording;
   4.   Prior to plat recordation and any additional development of the subsequent lots, the applicant must provide
        city staff the final plat mylar to include notarized signatures of owners’ consent to dedication; obtain
        signatures of all entities indicated on the subdivision plat attached hereto;
   5.   The applicant shall complete (or post an adequate improvement completion assurance), warrant and post
        required warranty assurance for all required landscaping and public infrastructure improvements;
   6.   The applicant shall ensure that all site improvements are installed consistent with the requirements of the South
        Salt Lake City Municipal Code;
   7.   The applicant shall dedicate an easement to the City of South Salt for purposes of storm water management
        practices and ensure the plat includes language of the dedication of such easement, in a form as approved by
        the City Attorney’s Office;
   8.   The proposed buildings shall be constructed according to South Salt Lake townhome design standards; and
   9.   All items of the staff report.


PLANNING COMMISSION OPTIONS:

Option 1: Approval
Move to approve the application by Kyle Denos, on behalf of Property Dynamics and 300 Lofts for a preliminary
subdivision plat for a 46-lot subdivision at the subject properties located at 3383 South 300 East, with the conditions
enumerated in the staff report and stated on the record.




                                                           10
Option 2: Denial
Move to deny the application by Kyle Denos, on behalf of Property Dynamics and 300 Lofts for a preliminary subdivision
plat for a 46-lot subdivision at the subject properties located at 3383 South 300 East, with the conditions enumerated
in the staff report and on the record..

Option 3: Continuance
Move to table the decision on the application by Kyle Denos, on behalf of Property Dynamics and 300 Lofts for a
preliminary subdivision plat for a 46-lot subdivision at the properties located at 3383 South 300 East to a date certain
to allow the Applicant and Staff time to respond to specific inquiries or concerns raised by the Planning Commission,
or to allow the Planning Commission more time to consider the proposal.

                                   PLANNING COMMISSION STAFF REPORT

MEETING DATE:             September 15, 2022
PROJECT NUMBER:           Z-21-005
REQUEST:                  A petition to the Planning Commission for a recommendation to the City Council to amend
                          the zoning for properties located at 3383 South 300 East and 354 East 3360 South to include
                          the Townhome Overlay (TO).
ADDRESS:                  3383 South 300 East and 354 East 3360 South
PARCEL NUMBER:            16-30-381-003; 004; 005; 006
                          16-30-456-003; 006; 016
PROPERTY OWNER:           300 Lofts, LLC
APPLICANT:                300 Lofts, LLC


 SYNOPSIS:
 300 Lofts, LLC is proposing redevelopment of seven existing parcels located at 3383 S. 300 E. and 354 E. 3360 S. In
 order to redevelop, the applicant is making two requests.

  1. 300 Lofts is petitioning the Planning Commission for preliminary plat approval for a 46-lot townhome
     subdivision located at 3383 S. 300 E. and 354 E. 3360 S.

  2. 300 Lofts is also petitioning the Planning Commission for a recommendation of approval to the City Council to
     amend the zoning to include the Townhome Overlay.

 The subject property currently has five existing buildings/structures that will be demolished. The applicant intends
 to construct 12 townhome buildings containing 45 dwelling units and common amenity space for the property
 owners.

 The Planning Commission
 is the advisory body to
 make recommendations to
 the City Council on all
 zoning map amendments.

                                    Operations

STAFF RECOMMENDATION:
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission forward a recommendation of approval to the City Council to
amend the zoning to include the Townhome Overlay. Staff’s recommendation is based upon its analysis and findings
included below.

PLANNING COMMISSION AUTHORITY:

17.11.010. Establishment and Duties of Planning Commission.
   K. Responsibilities.
         1. The Planning Commission makes recommendations to the City Council for:
         a. The general plan and amendments to the general plan;
         b. The Land Use Map, and amendments to the Land Use Map;
         c. Amendments to land use ordinances;
         d. Proposed Application processes and the delegation of power under the land use ordinance.

GENERAL PLAN CONSIDERATIONS:
Community Values Goal 2. Support neighborhood livability by creating pedestrian, bike, and play environments
appropriate to the surrounding housing types.

          Analysis: The proposed development will add to the livability of the area by adding new sidewalks, streets,
          and play environments within the development.

Community Values Goal 3. Take advantage of opportunities relating to the city’s location at the center of regional
transportation, transit, trials, open space, library, recreation, and school systems to serve residents, businesses, and
visitors.

          Analysis: The proposed development will be located 0.5 miles away from the new Granite Library. It is also
          surrounded by multiple bus stops as well as being 1 mile away from the Millcreek TRAX station.

Land Use & Neighborhoods Goal 1. Continue to welcome new residents and businesses into South Salt Lake.

          Analysis: The proposed development will create new housing for new residents to move into South Salt Lake.

Housing Goal 1. Encourage the equitable development of diverse, safe, affordable, and attractive housing that is
accessible and appropriate for residents of all incomes, needs, ages, backgrounds, and familial status.



                                                           6
          Analysis: The proposed development will add townhomes to an area that has multiple condominium and
          apartment buildings. This will add a different type of housing to the area that may be a better fit for potential
          residents than a condominium or apartment.

STAFF RECOMMENDATION:
Based upon the information submitted in the application, supporting documentation, and analysis of the relevant
code sections and general plan goals, staff recommends that the Planning Commission forward a recommendation of
approval to the City Council, with conditions, to amend the South Salt Lake Zoning Map to include the Townhome
Overlay and proposes the following findings of fact and conclusions of law and conditions of approval:

Findings of Fact:

   1.  The subject properties, located at 3383 South 300 East, consist of seven separate parcels.
   2.  All seven parcels are located in the Residential Multiple land use district.
   3.  The proposed zoning map amendment will add the Townhome Overlay (TO) to the existing zoning.
   4.  The proposed subdivision will create 46 lots that will total about 2.8 acres in size.
   5.  The property owner is applying for the subdivision and zoning amendment to construct a townhome
       development.
   6. The proposed development will be located in the Residential Multiple and Townhome Overlay land use
       districts.
   7. The proposed building falls into the Dwelling, Townhome land use category.
   8. The Dwelling, Townhome use is a permitted land use in the Townhome Overlay.
   9. The subject property currently has vacant buildings.
   10. The proposed project area will be served by new vehicular and pedestrian access points on 300 East and 3360
       South.
                                                        11
   11. Staff has reviewed this use for compliance with SSL Municipal Code Sections 17.03.270, 17.06 and 17.07, and
       found that this subdivision is use with those sections, as outlined above.

Conclusions of Law:

   1.   The use, as specifically conditioned below, is consistent with the South Salt Lake City General Plan.
   2.   The use, as specifically conditioned below is compatible in use, scale, and design with the allowed uses in
        Residential Multiple (RM) land use district and Townhome Overlay.
   3.   The use, as specifically conditioned below, does not compromise the health, safety, or welfare of: Persons
        employed within or using the proposed development; Those residing or working in the vicinity of the proposed
        use or development; or Property or improvements in the vicinity of the proposed use or development.
   4.   The use, as specifically conditioned below does not impose disproportionate burdens on the citizens of the
        city.

Conditions of Approval:

   1.   If approved, the petition for the zoning map amendment will not take effect until such time that the South Salt
        Lake Planning Commission grants the final plat approval of the subdivision plat, and said plat is recorded with
        the office of the Salt Lake County Recorder.
   2.   If approved and the applicant fails to record a final subdivision plat within 180 days of final subdivision plat
        approval, the zoning map amendment petition approval is void.
   3.   If approved, the petition for the zoning map amendment will not take effect until such time that the
        Development Agreement is executed.
   4.   All items of the staff report.


PLANNING COMMISSION OPTIONS:
Option 1: Approval
Move to forward a recommendation of approval of the application by 300 Lofts, LLC to the South Salt Lake City Council
to amend the South Salt Lake Zoning Map for the subject property located at 3383 South 300 East to include the
Townhome Overlay (TO).

Option 2: Denial
Move to forward a recommendation to deny the application by 300 Lofts, LLC to the South Salt Lake City Council to
amend the South Salt Lake Zoning Map for the subject property located at 3383 South 300 East to include the
Townhome Overlay (TO).

Option 3: Continuance
Move to table the decision on the application by 300 Lofts, LLC to the South Salt Lake City Council to amend the South
Salt Lake Zoning Map for the subject property located at 3383 South 300 East to include the Townhome Overlay (TO)
to a date certain to allow the Applicant and Staff time to respond to specific inquires or concerns raised by the Planning
Commission, or to allow the Planning Commission more time to consider the proposal.

    STATE / LOCAL) CODES AND REQUIREMENTS, PROJECT SPECIFICATIONS, CONTRACT DOCUMENTS, DRAWINGS
    AND GENERAL NOTES.
2. PRECEDENCE WILL TAKE PLACE IN THE FOLLOWING ORDER: APPLICABLE (FEDERAL / STATE / LOCAL) CODES
